verdict.rationale: Requesty documents an EU routing option that sends traffic through Frankfurt (AWS eu-central-1), and states that all processing and storage by Requesty stays in the EU, so users can choose an EU data-residency posture. However, this is a single first-party doc describing only one selectable region. missing for 10: evidence of regions beyond the EU, details on residency at downstream model providers, how to configure or enforce the region choice, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
